verdict.rationale: Feitian publishes first-party setup guides for registering keys with online accounts in general and with specific platforms (Microsoft, Azure AD-joined Windows, Google Advanced Protection), plus Bluetooth pairing instructions. The evidence consists only of guide titles, so the depth and clarity of the walkthroughs are unproven, and its tools (SK Manager, iePassManager) are described as management utilities rather than guided registration wizards. missing for 10: evidence of a guided setup app or wizard that walks users through account registration, detail showing the guides are step-by-step and clear, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the first-time setup experience.

support.subject: As a power user, first-time setup is guided — clear instructions or a setup app walk me through registering the key with my accounts
